title: D&D Beyond Level-Up Backlog
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:character class_name=* levelup_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(levelup_state!="applied",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by class_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending pending level-ups backlog by class for character administration.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside character administration.
implementation: Mark each `rpg:character` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `class_name`.
visualization: Table of class with pending pending level-ups counts.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds where unfinished pending level-ups are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in character administration.
